title: Device for controlling the flow of a fluid with in-built pressure threshold detection

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
features.note: This reference describes a valve for controlling fluid flow and detecting pressure thresholds, not a vacuum lifting device.

features.item: flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.note: This reference describes a valve with an internal and external element, not a suction cup with a flexible sealing lip.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
features.note: This reference describes a valve for fluid flow control, not a vacuum pump to draw air from a sealed region.

features.item: pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
features.quote: Valve with in-built pressure threshold detection, mounted in an engine block pipe, the valve comprising a body comprising an electrically insulating external element (16) and an electrically conducting internal element (18) bearing the shutoff-element seat (14), a shutoff element (12),
features.note: The reference describes a system for detecting a pressure threshold using an electrical circuit that changes state based on fluid pressure, which functions as a pressure sensor. However, it does not specifically monitor a 'vacuum level' in a 'sealed region' in the context of a lifting device.

features.item: warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
features.quote: Le système de détection détecte l'ouverture du circuit et en déduit que la pression du fluide est égale ou supérieure à la pression seuil. Le voyant lumineux s'éteint.
features.note: The reference describes a detection system that can activate a light indicator based on a pressure threshold. However, it does not specify that this threshold is 'above release vacuum level' or that it's for a vacuum lifting device.

features.item: warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
features.note: The reference discusses a pressure threshold for fluid flow control, but not a warning threshold defined relative to a load-release vacuum for a lifting device.

features.item: warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
features.note: (non-English passage at paragraph 74) The reference describes a light indicator that can be active when the pressure is below a threshold. However, it does not explicitly state that it 'remains active' while the condition persists, nor is it in the context of a 'grip vacuum' for a lifting device.
features.quote_src: Le système de détection détecte que la pression du fluide est inférieure à la pression seuil. Un voyant lumineux peut par exemple être allumé, celui-ci étant monté par exemple en série dans le circuit de détection.

features.item: rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
features.note: The reference mentions an electrical power supply for the detection system, but not a rechargeable battery integrated into a rigid body to power a vacuum pump.

features.item: warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
features.note: The reference mentions a light indicator but does not specify its positioning on a rigid body for visibility during a lifting operation.

features.item: single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.note: The reference describes a valve mounted in an engine block pipe, not a single-hand portable device with all components carried by a rigid body without external hose or cord.

overall.why: This reference describes a valve with integrated pressure threshold detection for fluid flow control in an engine block, which is a different technical field from a cordless handheld vacuum lifting device.
